messages.content: Translate each English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Preserve meaning, names, scripture references, and unit order. Do not add explanations or content. Output JSON only: {"book_code":"JASHER","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"source_ref":"1:1","text_ar":"..."}]}. Return exactly one row for each input source_ref.

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"source_ref":"8:15","chapter":8,"text":"And the king said to Terah, I have been told that a son was yesternight born to thee, and after this manner was observed in the heavens at his birth.","verse":15},{"source_ref":"8:16","chapter":8,"text":"And now therefore give me the child, that we may slay him before his evil springs up against us, and I will give thee for his value, thy house full of silver and gold.","verse":16},{"source_ref":"8:17","chapter":8,"text":"And Terah answered the king and said to him: My Lord and king, I have heard thy words, and thy servant shall do all that his king desireth.","verse":17},{"source_ref":"8:18","chapter":8,"text":"But my lord and king, I will tell thee what happened to me yesternight, that I may see what advice the king will give his servant, and then I will answer the king upon what he has just spoken; and the king said, Speak.","verse":18},{"source_ref":"8:19","chapter":8,"text":"And Terah said to the king, Ayon, son of Mored, came to me yesternight, saying,","verse":19}]}
